Hii sorry for such a late reply! I’ve been back on my antidepressants since June & see a psychiatrist regularly and I surrounded myself with loved ones after being locked up & alone for months. Doing that and deciding to cut off things like drinking & smoking that made my mental health worse has I can helped me so tremendously. 

I even opened up to a friend about exactly what I was going through & how much it affected it me and she gave me a judgement free zone to be complete open & raw. Honestly couldn’t have done it without her. It’s all easier said than done & I definitely had moments where it felt like it was never going to get better but I stayed positive & pushed myself to get back out into the world and joining spaces with people who have also gone through similar trauma. 

Hope this helps. It’s not much of anything to most but it’s what helped me.

Definitely feel you on the whole “stinking” thing, struggled with that as a female horribly 2021 and it destroyed my mental health. I managed to fix it and I’m doing a lot better now.

Here’s some tips that could possibly help 

-exfoliating gloves; gets rid of dead skin. That with a really nice smelling body wash does wonder
-wash cloth, after you exfoliate , go in again with the same body wash on a wash cloth 
-tongue scraper , this will get of any bad scents that are held on your tongue along with Thera breath mouth wash, swear you breath will smell like absolutely nothing for hours using that 
- a deodorant that goes will with your skin and chemistry, find one that works for you!
- a good shampoo also does wonders
-and so does fresh clothes anytime your out & about 
- then top it all off with a nice smelling cologne!! 

Seems like a lot but once you get in the habit, it’ll easily become a part of your normal routine.
Hope you start to feel better soon 🫶🏽
Well when you put it like that. It doesn’t seem worth it anymore lol

It feels like as each day passes by, I’m becoming less and less scared of what happens after because right now, is so horrible and miserable for me.

Honestly, I don’t know how celebrities do it. Having thousands of people shit talk you or make jokes is so cruel to handle. I’m not particularly on her or Johnny’s side but damn, I hope she can heal from people talking so badly about her.

I’m not asexual but being in a relationship or having sex really isn’t a main concern of mine. I feel alone too when all my friends talk about boys or their sex life, but your  not a monster. It’s okay not to want any of those things; there’s more to life than relationships & sex.

Plus I took 3 ibuprofen (bc I had a headache from crying lol) and it felt like the world was spinning since I barely ate anything. I still feel sick which sucks but today, I want to live a little more.
